notes.title: Loans Update is live
notes.notes:
Hello Traders

We are continuing to develop the Coin Trader Simulator. Feedback for our previous version focused on early game mechanics, more specifically about unpreventable bankruptcies because of a lack of sources in the early game. Our newest update includes two main changes;


Free Skill Points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531419/e01affdf1faa70777ef5b5b4dd5ee78b956ac47b.png

From now on, you will have three free skill points. You can use them to unlock another coin or acquire a skill to get money. It’s all up to you and your trading strategy. You will get extra skill points with each level, just as it is.



Loan

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531419/bfc0e89fc1e17a9007781bbaee871301efd5757d.png

We have been planning this new feature from the first day of the Coin Trader Simulator. From now on, you can borrow and invest with it under the “Personal.” But like the living cost debts, loan debts will increase each day with interest.

The total loan amount is limited to your house tier. By buying better houses, you can get more loan amounts.


Good luck and good earnings
